say:0:1111139001:0.text: The map we found shows the exact location of the treasure.
say:0:1111139001:0.source_cn: 之前在密道里找到的地图，上面画着挖掘宝藏的位置。
say:0:1111139001:0.male: The map we found shows the exact location of the treasure.
